styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte gypsum plaster wall #6E8A88 as the only wall, fine light wood plank flooring #D9C4A0 below, no other background or gradient
styleLock.lightingSystem: single soft key from front-left at 5200K neutral, gentle fill, soft-edged believable contact shadow, verticals kept vertical, no conflicting second light

styleLock.iconSystem: thin brass line square-bracket callouts #B08D57, 1.5px stroke, unfilled, no other icon shapes
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright slight 3/4 front angle, product stands on the floor and is never cropped at its base, verticals corrected to true vertical, one real-world scale-anchoring object per scene, consistent product scale across the set
noDrift: no color palette changes across the set
no inconsistent lighting direction or color temperature
no brand name, store name, logo, watermark, membership badge or QR code
no price, discount, coupon, or shipping claim
no dimensions, no shelf count beyond what is visible, no wood species, no panel grade, no formaldehyde figure, no load rating
no hardware brand, no warranty years, no certification, no test report, no standard number
no wall-mounted unit without visible fixing, no floating product, no tipping over, no sagging shelf, no child climbing or standing on shelves
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent muted blue-grey storage furniture ecommerce visual system; fixed palette of #6E8A88 wall, #F4EFE6 surfaces, #D9C4A0 pale wood and one #B08D57 metal accent; neutral 5200K; matte gypsum plaster wall #6E8A88 with fine light wood plank flooring #D9C4A0 as the only background; single soft front-left key at 5200K with soft-edged contact shadow and no second light source; modern geometric sans-serif; thin line square-bracket callouts in #B08D57, 1.5px stroke, unfilled; stable upright slight 3/4 presentation, verticals true, real floor contact, one scale-anchoring object per scene; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no watermarks, no prices, no numeric or certification claims.

provenance.notes: 源 12 片，归档于 _sources/置物柜/panels/。panel-02/03 的圆图卖点行重复、panel-03/04 与 07/08 的同句大标题重复，合并入痛点镜与信任镜；panel-09/10 的规格与参数表并入对比镜与选款镜，panel-11/12 的细节图并为两枚细节镜。品类判定：主体为落地、开放层架、可叠组合的储物柜（含抽屉底座），非壁挂非带门柜，故入家具家纺·收纳家具。主体风格取自源页灰蓝绿石膏墙加米白文案、黄铜细线方括号图标与正面偏左柔光。
